title: DJ's Spellcasting
description: Project that adds spellcasting with accurate movements that you can add your own spells to.
body:
Spellcasting adds a lightweight spell system to Minecraft datapacks, starting with the classic Leviosa spell — lift your enemies into the air and watch them float helplessly!

🔮 Features

Leviosa: a built-in spell that levitates enemies when cast.

Extendable system: easily add your own spells with full control over particles, effects, and behavior.

Spell generator: create and package new spells in seconds using the web tool 👉 [Spellcasting Generator](https://djush0rts.github.io/Spellcasting)
.

Datapack friendly: everything is built using Minecraft functions and storage, no mods required.
